title: Frontend: Progress bar component — auto vs manual progress, override input
description: Create a reusable project progress bar that shows auto-calculated and manual override progress, with an inline input to set the manual override.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows progress bar filled to effectiveProgress (manual if set, else auto)
If progressManual is set, shows a 'Manual override active' indicator with a reset button
Pencil icon to open inline override input (number 0-100)

steps.details: Create src/components/project/ProjectProgressBar.tsx. Props: project. Compute effectiveProgress = project.progressManual ?? project.progressAuto. Use shadcn/ui Progress. Show label: 'N%'. If progressManual set, show yellow/orange indicator.

Pencil icon button → shows inline Input (0-100). Submit on Enter or checkmark button. Calls PATCH /api/projects/:id/progress. On success: invalidate project query. Reset button (x) → sets progressManual to null.
Set manual override to 75 — verify progress bar shows 75% even if auto is 20%. Reset — verify bar returns to auto. Complete more todos — verify auto progress updates independently.
